card.text: A Cepheid in the Andromeda Galaxy, 761 kiloparsecs away, that swells and shrinks every 31.4 days.

introduction.text: Edwin Hubble's M31-V1 is the first Cepheid found in the Andromeda Galaxy. Its galaxy's distance, 761 kiloparsecs, was measured from Cepheids like it.
